title: AdPilot
subtitle: Agentic Campaign Optimization Copilot
stage: P0 verified locally · P0.5 validated on the frozen case · P1 architecture proposed
problem: Performance marketers spend too much time investigating campaign performance issues and implementing optimization changes. AdPilot aims to surface only a handful of well-supported opportunities, not another barrage of alerts.
summary: A real LLM agent investigates synthetic acquisition campaigns through advertising tools, explains evidence and uncertainty, prepares bounded budget transfers, and requires human approval before applying simulated changes.

achievements: A hosted Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite model, orchestrated through the OpenAI Agents SDK, performed genuine multi-step advertising tool calls.
One Terminal investigation made eight tool calls; a local Streamlit session displayed 13 tool calls and a completed synthetic approval workflow.
A human-approved $50/day transfer updated two campaign budgets from $500 to $450 and $300 to $350, while preserving an $800 combined daily budget.

p05.status: The final live run passed 10/10 process checks with one account snapshot, one preview, and an explicit EU–U.S. trade-off.
findings: A live six-campaign review exposed uneven donor/receiver conversion checks; a workflow gate was installed and explicit two-sided maturity reads were subsequently observed.
A saved trace regraded at 10/10 revised automated process checks, but its US-versus-EU comparative reasoning remained incomplete; these are not recommendation-precision metrics.
An expanded comparison investigation exceeded the 15-turn ceiling, and a separate attempt hit the Gemini 15-RPM quota. Model requests are not identical to tool calls.
The final frozen run used one evidence snapshot across six campaigns, followed by one preview with zero repeated evidence checks or budget changes.
next: Rerun abstention and human-approval boundary regression cases and document remaining failures.
Keep process-rubric scores separate from independent recommendation-quality judgments and advertiser impact.

principles: Quality over quantity: zero to three evidence-backed recommendations.
LLM for investigation and explanation; deterministic code for metrics, policy and safety.
Explicit human approval for all synthetic campaign changes.
evidence_note: The final frozen live run passed 10/10 automated checks. Product review accepted the EU–U.S. trade-off for the proposed $25/day synthetic pilot. Provider requests, latency and advertiser impact remain unmeasured.
limitation: Local Streamlit prototype, synthetic data only. No public live demo yet, no real ad-platform integration, no measured advertiser time savings, and no demonstrated CPA or conversion lift.

p1.decision: Defer full-scale architecture until six-campaign agent usefulness and evaluation quality are demonstrated.
p1.design: Batch/paginated ingestion → deterministic eligibility screening and evidence shortlist → Gemini comparison and on-demand deeper investigation → independent safety rules and human approval.
p1.eval_focus: Pre-screening opportunity recall, supported recommendation quality, critical safety, latency, provider requests/tokens, and estimated cost at realistic account sizes.
